name: Luis
site: robinson.com · Resort holidays for families, Germany
headline: Turn Robinson’s booking data into holidays that get rebooked.
saw: Your homepage sells ROBINSON resort holidays to families, couples and singles, and puts the same Early Bird Summer 2027 offer, up to 20% off, in front of every visitor.

Inside your app or My account, what guests book, which family or travel offers they open and when they return is your strongest signal for the next booking. Today it sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The guest who is about to walk away this week gets the same early bird mail as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Reach the guest before they walk away
cases.text: Per guest signals from bookings, app visits and My account flag who is drifting away. The AI picks the right offer, channel and moment for each one, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Match each family to the right offer
cases.text: Next best holiday and add-on per guest, drawn from past bookings and the offers they actually open. No more blanket early bird mails to guests who have already booked.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep guests dreaming between bookings
cases.text: Personal resort, sport and childcare content in the app, push and email, so every guest has a reason to open ROBINSON again before they book.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
